overview: Copie Past-e is a SaaS marketplace listing manager running on the Internet Computer. Users can archive, manage, and repost marketplace listings with Stripe-powered subscriptions, Smart Photo OCR via Gemini, and a full admin control panel.
features: Stripe subscription payments via ICP polling/verification (no webhooks)
Gemini OCR for smart photo listing extraction
Stable variable config that survives every canister upgrade
Admin control panel with payments, debugger, backup, and user management
Tiered subscriptions (Time Walker, Time Traveler, Time Lord)
Gas Wallet with fuel level display
